source_evidence: For example, your beneficiary may receive the greater of: (i) all the money in your account; or (ii) some guaranteed minimum, such as all purchase payments minus prior withdrawals.
question: During the accumulation phase of a variable annuity, what might its death benefit provide to a beneficiary?
answer: A death benefit may provide the beneficiary you selected with money. Depending on the contract, the beneficiary might receive the greater of the account value or a guaranteed minimum, such as purchase payments minus prior withdrawals.
